loop.task: Lower the held-out loss of the character-level language model that train.py trains on data/train.txt. A run trains for 30 seconds (--time-budget 30, fixed) and must save model.ts the way train.py does now: a TorchScript module that maps token ids of shape [64, 128] to logits of shape [64, 128, 65], which the frozen evaluate.py scores. Everything inside train.py may change: model, optimiser, schedule, precision, data sampling.
